name: prevenza-mobile
description: Prevenza: Scam Guard for Android (Capacitor). The app files are copied from the website and the extension by scripts/build-mobile.js; there is no second copy of the detection code.

scripts.apk: node ../scripts/build-mobile.js && cap sync android && cd android && .\gradlew.bat assembleDebug
scripts.apk:release: node ../scripts/build-mobile.js && cap sync android && cd android && .\gradlew.bat assembleRelease
